name: SkillShooter
postCreateCommand: go build -o skillshooter-server ./cmd/skillshooter-server && go build -o skillshooter-client ./cmd/skillshooter-client
postStartCommand: pgrep -f 'skillshooter-server [s]erve' >/dev/null || (nohup ./skillshooter-server serve >> serve.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1 ; cat serve.log
postAttachCommand: pgrep -f 'skillshooter-server [s]erve' >/dev/null || (nohup ./skillshooter-server serve >> serve.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1 ; tail -1 serve.log
